strategyFamily: identity-clean successor to Trial 3 low-turnover cross-sectional spot expected-return selection
reasonForNewTrial: Trial 3 development was already observed when a material universe data-identity exception was discovered: Binance LUNAUSDT history spans old-LUNA/LUNC and new-LUNA underlying assets. The frozen Trial 3 no-data-integrity-exception promotion criterion therefore failed. Trial 14 repairs only the prospective universe identity rule under a new numbered trial; it does not alter Trial 3 in place.

inheritExactly: pooled ridge model with lambda 10 and 12-month minimum training
permittedDifferences: universe identity-stability filter and resulting membership
provenance fields required to document the identity repair

identityStabilityRule.definition: A ranked symbol is eligible only if the exchange ticker represents one continuous economically equivalent underlying asset throughout every formation/history row used under that symbol. Exclude a symbol if first-party issuer/exchange evidence shows that, during the relevant history, the same ticker was reassigned across distinct chains/tokens or the exchange's historical kline endpoint intentionally concatenates predecessor and successor underlying assets.

frozenIdentityExceptions.reason: Original Terra LUNA became Luna Classic/LUNC and a distinct new Terra chain/token assumed ticker LUNA in May 2022; Binance historical LUNA/USDT klines include the pre-2022-05-31 Terra Classic history.

identityStabilityRule.membershipRule: Starting from the already-frozen Trial 3 2022-only eligible liquidity ranking, remove every frozen identity exception, preserve original rank order for all remaining rows, and select the first 30.

finalAccessGateFrozenBeforeDevelopment.note: Failure of this gate locks Trial 14 without opening the 2026 final holdout. Passing the gate permits, but does not itself execute, a separately protected one-shot final evaluation.

antiRescue: After the first Trial 14 development result is observed, no change to the identity rule, exception registry, membership, base Trial 3 mechanics, lambda, features, costs, dates, sizing, rebalance frequency, comparators, development gate, or promotion thresholds is allowed under Trial 14. Any such change is a new numbered alpha trial.
